# Gullak

> Gullak is a free expense tracker for people in India. It reads the SMS your bank already sends (forwarded by an iPhone Shortcut) and turns each one into a sorted, totalled expense, so there is nothing to type. No bank login. It installs from Safari on iPhone as a Home Screen app; an Android app is planned but not released.

Made by [Piyush Dhoka](https://piyush.sparkstudio.co.in/).

## How it works
- You pay with GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, BHIM or a card, and your bank sends its usual SMS.
- A Shortcuts automation on your iPhone forwards that SMS to Gullak. It runs on its own.
- Gullak reads the amount, payee and category, skips duplicates, and sends a notification. If it cannot tell a payee (for example a chai stall's QR code), it asks you once.

## Privacy
- Only messages that look like bank or payment SMS are kept. Personal messages are dropped immediately without being stored.
- No bank login, no bank passwords and no account linking.
- Runs on Gullak's own server, not an ad network.

## Install (iPhone)
1. Open https://gullak.sparkstudio.co.in in Safari on your iPhone.
2. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
3. Open Gullak from the Home Screen and create your account.
It is not in the App Store; it updates itself and does not expire.

## Features
- Automatic categories for UPI, card, NEFT/IMPS, ATM and salary SMS from major Indian banks (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Yes, IDFC FIRST and more).
- A notification for every payment, budgets per category, Gullak Jars for savings goals, and Gullu, a chat assistant for your spending.
- UPI Lite and cash usually send no SMS, so those are added by hand.
